days.title: Wine Culture and History
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Handthal
stops.detail: In fact, a lot revolves around the liquid grape gold for this cheerful character from Handthal in Lower Franconia.

stops.name: Stollburg Castle
stops.detail: The “Weg der Erkenntnis” (path of knowledge) leading up to Stollburg Castle helps to combat incomplete wine knowledge.

stops.name: Ebrach monastery
stops.detail: It is also about the Cistercians who once lived in the nearby Ebrach monastery and introduced viticulture to the region.

days.title: Nature Education and Forest Trails
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Francis Trail
stops.detail: One would love to join the regular hikers passing by, be it on one of the many trails starting here or at least on the short “Francis Trail” with its thought-provoking stations such as a walk-in bee house.

stops.name: Steigerwald Centre
stops.detail: The bee house is located next to the Steigerwald Centre, the ideal starting point for any tour.
